scope: Four shuffled variants, seven question types, student and answer exports in PDF and DOCX.
observations: Inline and fenced code render without Markdown delimiters in PDF and DOCX.
Pipe-delimited Markdown renders as a bordered table in both formats.
LaTeX input renders as MathML in PDF and native OMML in DOCX.
A data-URI PNG renders in all four student variants; remote/file URLs remain blocked to prevent SSRF and local-file disclosure.
Raw HTML is escaped and DOCX heading colors are explicitly black.
All final pages under qa-rich-final2 were inspected after the final regeneration.
